tei:div.tei:p: 237) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i rtsa sgrub byang chub lam bzang dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: 238) na mo padma kā ra ye: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: ḍā ki bde chen mtsho rgyal ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skyob pa'i phyir: bod 'bangs 'gro ba'i mgon cig pu: 'phags pa 'gro 'dul pad dkar 'chang: snying rje'i mnga' bdag sgrub pa'i thabs: byang chub lam bzang 'di ru bkod: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: nyams dga' skyon bral dben pa'i gnas: byin chags bkod legs yid 'ong sar: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang yo byad sogs: nyer mkho'i longs spyod 'du bar bya: gsang sgo ma 'chal tshul bzhin du: bde sar sgrub pa'i rten gtor sogs: phyi nang mchod pa'i yo byad bsag: sgrub pa'i bar chad sel pa'i phyir: dkar phyogs mgron la phrin las bcol: nag phyogs bgegs la 'bras chan glud: 'dod yon rdzas su dmigs te bsngo: sa ma ya: de nas sngon 'gro'i rim pa la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni:

na mo: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can kun: byang chub snying po ma thob bar: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum brjod mthar sems bskyed ni: hoḥ ma gyur mkha' khyab sems can rnams: bla med byang chub myur 'thob phyir: 'phags 239)mchog thugs rje chen po yi: zung 'jug dkyil 'khor bsgom sems bskyed: lan gsum brjod mthar yan bdun ni: hoḥ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo: lus dang longs spyod dngos kun mchod par 'bul: mi dge'i las kun snying nas mthol zhing bshags: rang gzhan rnam dkar dge la rjes yi rangs: gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rgyal kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: dge tshogs rgya mtsho 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: ma lus rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sa 'thob shog: ces brjod tshogs zhing rang la bsdu: sgo gsum smin cing grol bar bsam: bgegs srung brda sgo dbye ba dang: brda phyag 'tshal dang dam bca' gzung: byin dbab mchod rdzas byin brlab dang: dkyil 'khor 'jug bshags la sogs pa: las rim brgyad pa gzhan du gsal: gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgom pa ni: āḥ chos rnams dmigs med stong par gyur: stong nyid gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ger shar: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su: lhun grub bde chen gzhal yas khang: tshad dang 240) mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus: padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: dbyings nas sa bon gdan la babs: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal kun mchod: mkhyen brtse nus dpal yon tan bsdus: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: dwangs bcud nus pa rang la bstim: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro 'dul 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsal 'tsher 'od 'bar zla ba'i mdog: nyag gcig zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdzes:

don gnyis snyan gyi padmo rgyas: mkhyen gnyis ye shes spyan dang ldan: bden pa dbyer med shangs bug har: mtshan bzang so gnyis tshems phreng mdzes: shes rab mnga' brnyes ljags pad srab: tshad med thugs rje'i phyag bzhi pa: dang pos thugs kar thal mo sbyar: 'og gnyis shel phreng pad dkar bsnams: sku la longs spyod rgyan rnams rdzogs: thabs shes zhabs gnyis skyil krung gis: skyon bral pad nyi zla gdan bzhugs: snang la rang bzhin ma grub sku: 'ja' tshon bzhin du wa ler gsal: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: 'od snang mtha' yas sku mdog dmar: 241)mnyam gzhag skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: snang stong sgyu ma'i lha skur shar: g.yas su pad nyi zla dkyil steng: mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal ni: gur gum mdog can zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis shes rab ral gri dang: utpal steng na glegs bam bsnams: thod bcings zar bu sku rgyab grol: rin chen dbu brgyan rtse bran mdzes: stod g.yog smad dkris rin chen brgyan: longs sku'i chas rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs: g.yon du mthu stobs mnga' bdag ni: nam mkha'i mdog can gzi 'od 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan zung ldan: g.yas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin : g.yon pas utpal yu ba ni: 'dab ma snyan thad rgyas pa bsnams: sku la dar dang rin chen spras: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs skyil krung gis: padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs kyi: spyi bor oṃ dang mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: dbyings bzhugs ye shes lha yi tshogs: 'gro 'dul 242)'phags pa'i rnam rol du: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med gyur: zhes brjod dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: spyan drangs chu la char thim bzhin:

gnyis med ro gcig gyur par bsam: spyan 'dren dang ni bzhugs gsol dang: phyag 'tshal mchod pa bstod pa sogs: las rim lnga pa gzhan du gsal: de nas 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka ru: pad zla'i steng du thugs srog hrīḥ de'i mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: bzlas pas snod bcud gnyis snang sems: rang grol sku gsung thugs su smin: gtso 'khor srog sngags ro gcig gyur: dag pa rab 'byams bde ba che: ma yengs mi sgom gzer gyis ni: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang du bzla: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de ltar ma yengs ting 'dzin ngang: sngags dag mi tshig ma 'dres par: snyen sgrub zab mor brtson gyur na: rab dngos 'bring nyams tha na yang: rmi lam nyid du 'grub pa'i rtags: rang 'bras mngon du gyur par nges: bskyed rdzogs rnam grangs mang mi dgos: bod 'bangs lha skal 'gro ba'i mgon: 'di nyid gcig pus dngos grub thob: sa ma ya: rab la dgongs pa mi g.yo zhing: chos nyid bden pa mngon mthong nas: lha dang rang snang chos nyid gsum: 243) dbyer med du ma ro gcig ngang: mi 'gyur lta ba'i gding thob bo: 'bring la lha zhal mthong ba'am: dkyil 'khor bri dang zhing khams mjal: lha dang mkha' 'gro lung yang ston: tha mas gos dkar gyon pa dang: nyi ma shar dang ri rtser 'dzeg: shel phreng rnyed sogs rtags mtshan mngon: de dag gang dang gang byung yang: gnyis 'dzin re dgos dgag sgrub spongs: ro snyoms chen po'i brtul zhugs spyod: 'phags pa 'grub pa'i rtags su shes: sa ma ya: rjes rim bsod nams bsags pa la: tshogs mchod zab mor brtson pa'i thabasaḥ thabs shes rdzas rnams 'du byas nas: rgya che grangs mang bkod legs pa: mchod pa'i rigs rnams thams cad kun: ri rab rol mtsho'i tshul du bshams: nang mchod la sogs bcas kyis bran: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros pa yis:

tshogs kyi nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs: bsregs gtor bkrus pas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ gyis sku yi bdud rtsi dkar: āḥyis gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar: hūm̐ gis thugs kyi bdud rtsi mthing: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs khyab gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa= sogs: swā hā: lan gsum gyis byin brlabs: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: 244) hūm̐: rang snang dag pa 'og min gnas kyi mchog: lhun grub bkod pa rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas nas: sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mdzes khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lha dang rang snang gnyis med gus phyag 'tshal: snang srid rnam dag bde stong mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i klong du bshags: 'khor gsum 'dzin pa bral la rjes yi rangs: yang dag bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: 'pho med gzhon nu bum skur bzhugs gsol 'debs: khams gsum sku gsum klong grol byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ ārya lo ki shwa ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid rnam dag mchod pa'i sprin: bde chen bla med gsang ba'i rdzas: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par rol: ma hā ga ṇa 245)tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: sgo gsum bag med ci bgyis pa: longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad nas kyang: sor chud dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra sa twa sa ma ya= sogs: āḥ de nas nyams pa bsgral ba ni:

hūm̐: srid pa e yi brub khung du: bdag lta'i gzung 'dzin ru tra bkug: bdag med rol pa'i mtshon gyis bsgral: 'khrul med ka dag dbyings su āḥ de nas zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstabs: lhag ma med par bzhes nas kyang: 'khrul med chos sku'i sa ru drongs: sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya kha raṃ khā hi: de nas drang ba ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i rdzas mchog 'di: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsi che: gtsang rme gnyis 'dzin bsam pa spongs: tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la hoḥ de nas lhag ma ni: hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe rgyal 246)ba'i spyan snga ru: bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs shing: rdo rje'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i: lhag skyong gnas nyul pho mo'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs lhag rol: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las: gang bsam 'dod don yongs 'grub mdzod: sarba sa ma ya utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas smon lam ni: hoḥ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: rang rig chos sku mngon gyur nas: gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par shog: ces brjod lhag ma gtsang sar gshegs: rjes kyi las rim gzhan du gsal: sa ma ya: e ma: shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa: pad 'byung thugs dam kho mo bdag gis rnyed: snying mig srog dang mchungs pa'i gdams pa 'di: a tsarya dang zhi ba mtsho la gtad: da dung ma spel 'phrul gyi brda ru thob: snyigs 'dus nyi shu kha ral dus kyi tshe: 'di yi brda bsgyur mi mo yos 'brug lo: thugs kyi ming 'dzin lha ldan phyogs nas 'ong: mdo khams yul gsum de yi gdul byar 'gyur: rten dang 'brel 'byung sapdas ma bsgyur na: sa gter skor gsum snyan brgyud chos la dbang: dkar po lha gsum chos kyi sgo 'phar dbye: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba lha mchog 'di yis 'dren:

grogs dang 247) chos bdag smon lam dbang gis 'phrad: (Dakini secret letter here) bka' 'di dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thub bar srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang nye gnas yi ge'i 'du byed shī la badzra gnyis kyi thugs bzhed skong phyir du snyoms las pa bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa dge'o// he he/ mgo med mjug med 'bu nag gzugs 'dra'i chos// jo min nag min rgan min gzhon min ngas// yig min ris min spos rgya'i rnam pa can// bu min bu 'dra tshul khrims rdo rje yi// dal min brel min nyi ma 'gro phyir phul/ gcus 'khrugs che bas nan gzab gzigs par zhu// dge'o// 248)
